description_en: Retrieves the list of attack types for the attack analysis event display
description_zh: 攻击分析事件展示中获取攻击类型列表
name: GetAttackTypeList

Label.description_en: The internationalization (i18n) translation key of the attack type, such as sas.attack.type.type12. The caller must resolve this key by using internationalization resources to obtain a human-readable attack type name
Label.description_zh: 攻击类型的国际化（i18n）翻译键，例如 sas.attack.type.type12。调用方需要通过国际化资源解析该键，获取人类可读的攻击类型名称

Status_Type.description_en:
The attack source. Valid values:

cfw: Cloud Firewall.
alinet: Network defense plugin.
waf: Web Application Firewall (WAF)
Status_Type.description_zh:
攻击来源。取值：

cfw：云防火墙
alinet：网络防御插件
waf：WEB应用防火墙

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. Alibaba Cloud generates a unique identifier for each request. You can use the request ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
